query:
INSERT INTO email_change_requests (user_id, new_email, token_hash, expires_at)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
               ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
               SET new_email = EXCLUDED.new_email,
                   token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash,
                   expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
                   created_at = NOW()
